description: Wondering is the most delightful way to break down complex topics into knowledge you can remember and apply. name: Your AI Lecture & Meeting Assistant
tagline: AI notes and smart questions for better learning
description: Logiqnote is an AI-powered learning and collaboration assistant that helps you ask the right questions at the right time. While you attend a lecture or meeting, Logiqnote generates smart, contextual questions in real time to clarify doubts and deepen understanding. Beyond summaries and notes, it transforms passive listening into active thinking, helping students and teams engage, retain, and collaborate better.

name: Yrkie
tagline: AI presentations for serious professional work
description: Yrkie is an AI presentation workspace built on a fully proprietary presentation stack—from its multi-agent framework and presentation schema to its canvas rendering engine and editable PPTX pipeline. Think of it as an AI-native presentation language: it gives models structural control over narrative, layout, and visuals instead of forcing content into templates. Create from prompts and files, improve existing PPTX files, review the outline, refine the deck, and export an editable PowerPoint.
